Read input: rtlpp_11455_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_11455 (
    input  [1:0] address,
    input        chipselect,
    input        clk,
    input        reset_n,
    input        write_n,
    input        writedata,
    output       out_port,
    output       readdata
);

    reg data_out;
    
    always @(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) begin
        if (!reset_n)
            data_out <= 0;
        else if (chipselect && ~write_n && (address == 0))
            data_out <= writedata;
    end

    assign readdata = (address == 0) ? data_out : 0;
    assign out_port = data_out;

endmodule
